The AI system, style B: three variants

One big general part in the model's hue, one small part in the job's colour plugged into it, and the network's last column lit by that colour: the column the fine-tuned layer re-trains. Flat, banded and lit from the top left like the people; computing equipment first, a neural network second. Every specimen is drawn by system in world/concepts/calibration/B-system/, calling general_model and fine_tuned_layer, at whole size (one pixel per unit), at 1/3 and at 1/20; below each, the doctor's, the taxonomist's and the lawyer's systems at half size.

The three variants

system, "chip"

(i) A processor chip seen from above, standing on its pins, its die carrying the network; a small chip in the job's colour is seated in the socket at its corner.

system, "screen"

(ii) A monitor whose screen shows the network; a cartridge in the job's colour is pushed into the port in its side.

system, "board"

(iii) A circuit board in the model's hue with a big chip carrying the network; an add-on card in the job's colour stands in the connector on its top edge.
